json_ld.description:
The industry uses plastic, we use wool. While the industry largely relies on polyester for fleece items, we’re proud of our new natural wool fleece shirt jacket that's breathable, odor-resistant, and quick-drying.

The Woolaroo’s natural softness offers freedom of movement while keeping you warm.

And yes, while wool does shed, it’s a natural fiber that will break down rather than contribute to the plastic pollution problem.
  • Sorted, recycled, spun, and woven in Italy, our partner Manteco created a plush fabric that is made completely of recycled wool, helping to divert pre- and post-consumer virgin wool textiles from landfills and putting this valuable fiber back into circulation.
  • The color in this garment is made from combining recycled pre- and post-consumer waste, which helps to spare the use of any additional water or dyestuffs.
  • A relaxed shirt jacket that's roomy enough for easy layering over all your cool-weather favorites.
  • Oversized chest and side seam pockets and corozo nut button closure.
  • Unlined, clean finished internal seams with organic cotton binding.
